
```{r load}
# ── inputs (keep next to this Rmd) ─────────────────────────────────────
xlsx_path <- "BISAC 2025 to Thema 1.6 Mapping_Public.xlsx"
map_path  <- "bisac_section_mappings.tsv"

raw <- read_excel(xlsx_path) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(as.character(.), "")))

maps <- read_tsv(map_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# join section / DDC / LCSH by 3-letter prefix
raw <- raw |>
  mutate(prefix = substr(`BISAC Code`, 1, 3)) |>
  left_join(maps, by = "prefix") |>
  mutate(
    section = coalesce(section, prefix),
    ddc     = coalesce(ddc, "—"),
    lcsh    = coalesce(lcsh, "—")
  )

# collapse Thema + qualifier columns into display strings
collapse_pair <- function(df, code_cols, lit_cols) {
  apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    parts <- character(0)
    for (i in seq_along(code_cols)) {
      c <- row[[code_cols[i]]]
      lit <- row[[lit_cols[i]]]
      if (nzchar(c)) {
        parts <- c(parts, if (nzchar(lit)) paste0(c, " — ", lit) else c)
      }
    }
    paste(parts, collapse = " | ")
  })
}

raw$thema <- collapse_pair(
  raw,
  paste0("Thema Code ", 1:4),
  paste0("Thema Literal ", 1:4)
)
raw$qual <- collapse_pair(
  raw,
  paste0("Qual Code ", 1:4),
  paste0("Qual Literal ", 1:4)
)

tbl <- raw |>
  transmute(
    seq = as.integer(seq),
    bisac = `BISAC Code`,
    section,
    thema,
    qual,
    ddc,
    lcsh
  )

n_codes <- nrow(tbl)

```

```{r table}
# HTML helpers for Thema / qualifier badges
fmt_codes <- JS("
  function(data, type) {
    if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data || '—';
    return data.split(' | ').map(function(part) {
      var m = part.match(/^([A-Z0-9\\-]+)\\s*—\\s*(.*)$/);
      if (m) return '<span class=\"badge\">' + m[1] + '</span>' + m[2];
      return part;
    }).join('<br>');
  }
")

fmt_qual <- JS("
  function(data, type) {
    if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data || '—';
    return data.split(' | ').map(function(part) {
      var m = part.match(/^([A-Z0-9\\-]+)\\s*—\\s*(.*)$/);
      if (m) return '<span class=\"badge badge-q\">' + m[1] + '</span>' + m[2];
      return part;
    }).join('<br>');
  }
")

datatable(
  tbl,
  rownames = T,
  escape = FALSE,
  class = "display stripe compact",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    lengthMenu = c(25, 50, 100, 250, 500),
    order = list(list(0, "asc")),
    stateSave = FALSE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    # we drive search from #q — keep DT search enabled but hidden via CSS
    searching = TRUE,
    search = list(regex = FALSE, smart = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = "bisac", targets = 1),
      list(className = "section", targets = 2),
      list(className = "ddc", targets = 5),
      list(className = "lcsh", targets = 6),
      list(targets = 3, render = fmt_codes),
      list(targets = 4, render = fmt_qual)
    ),
    language = list(
      search = "",
      lengthMenu = "Show _MENU_",
      info = "_START_–_END_ of _TOTAL_",
      infoFiltered = "(filtered from _MAX_)",
      paginate = list(previous = "‹", `next` = "›")
    ),
    # callback: wire external search + regex toggle (DGB-style)
    initComplete = JS("
      function(settings, json) {
        var api = this.api();
        var q = document.getElementById('q');
        var re = document.getElementById('re');
        var reToggle = document.getElementById('reToggle');
        var reErr = document.getElementById('reErr');
        var shown = document.getElementById('shown');
        var clearBtn = document.getElementById('clear');

        function applySearch() {
          var term = (q.value || '').trim();
          var useRe = re.checked;
          reErr.classList.remove('show');

          if (useRe && term) {
            try {
              new RegExp(term); // validate
            } catch (e) {
              reErr.textContent = 'Invalid regex: ' + e.message;
              reErr.classList.add('show');
              api.search('').draw();
              return;
            }
            // DataTables regex mode (no smart tokenizing)
            api.search(term, true, false).draw();
          } else {
            // normal smart multi-token search
            api.search(term, false, true).draw();
          }
          var info = api.page.info();
          shown.textContent = info.recordsDisplay.toLocaleString();
        }

        q.addEventListener('input', applySearch);
        re.addEventListener('change', function() {
          reToggle.classList.toggle('active', re.checked);
          q.placeholder = re.checked
            ? 'RegExp (e.g. ^FIC.*|MED0[0-2])…'
            : 'Search all fields…';
          applySearch();
        });
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          q.value = '';
          re.checked = false;
          reToggle.classList.remove('active');
          q.placeholder = 'Search all fields…';
          reErr.classList.remove('show');
          applySearch();
          q.focus();
        });

        // keep count in sync on any draw (paging / sort)
        api.on('draw', function() {
          var info = api.page.info();
          shown.textContent = info.recordsDisplay.toLocaleString();
        });

        // / focuses search
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement !== q) {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.focus();
            q.select();
          }
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.activeElement === q) q.blur();
        });

        applySearch();
      }
    ")
  ),
  colnames = c("#", "BISAC", "Section", "Thema subject(s)", "Qualifier(s)", "DDC ≈", "LCSH ≈")
)
```
